final: WITH ranked_schools AS (SELECT s.School, s.County, ss.AvgScrRead, s.Virtual, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC) as county_rank FROM schools s JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds WHERE ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL) SELECT School FROM ranked_schools WHERE Virtual = 'F' AND county_rank <= 5 ORDER BY School
